The safe-to-spend number

How is it worked out?
Your monthly income, minus everything that has gone out this month, divided by the days left in the month, today included. “Gone out” means expenses, Daret contributions, savings goal deposits, debt payments and money you paid back to a friend.
Why didn’t my ATM withdrawal lower it?
A withdrawal moves money from your bank account to your cash. It’s still yours, so it isn’t counted as spending. What you buy with that cash is.
Where do I set my monthly income?
In Settings. The number uses that figure, so keep it up to date when your income changes.
Why did the number go up overnight?
Each morning, what’s left is shared across one fewer day. If you spent less than your number yesterday, the difference is spread over the rest of the month.

Using the app

How do I change the language or currency?
In Settings. VVollet is available in 16 languages, including Arabic, French and English.
How do I add a Daret group?
Open Wealth, then Daret. Enter the contribution per share, the number of shares, how many you hold, the payment day and which months the pot comes to you.
Does it work offline?
Yes. Changes are saved on your phone and sync to your account when you’re back online.
How do I lock the app?
In Settings, under security, set a PIN. You can also hide your balances in the app switcher.

Your account and data

Can I get a copy of my data?
Yes. Go to Settings → Data & storage and export it.
How do I delete my account?
Follow the steps on Delete your account.
Who can see my numbers?
Only you. Our privacy policy explains what we store and which services receive any of it.
